doc.title: Mildred Major and Emma Zeno Interview, 1969-03-28

title: Memories of her grandfather and the camp near Mandeville
summary: She remembers her grandfather like a shadow, then a place near Mandeville where her father was at a camp, recalling only water and a crane.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You actually confirmed my grandfather this morning. I don't remember him too well. I remember him like a shadow, a small house. I was just a kid. Mm-hmm. Very little. And the next memories I have with my father was Regalige. And all I can remember then is water and a crane.
What was this, did you say?
Regalige. Remember his liege was. Regalige.
Regalige. He was with the, uh, camp camp. Uh, camp, huh?
You know, small, real small then. And all I can remember is water and a crane. That's all I can remember. You know, cranes to come every day.
And this is at Mandeville you're talking about?
No, this is in Regalige. Regalige.
Regalige. Regalige. Where the palace is that?
Oh, it's close to now. It's close to Mandeville. Yeah.
